title: REQ · zustand is declared in package.json and locked in package-lock.json
summary: The frontend manifest and lockfile both include zustand as a runtime dependency.
description: Context: no zustand entry in game/frontend/package.json or package-lock.json. Desired behavior: add the dependency with npm so both files agree. Expected result: manifest range matches the lockfile root entry and a resolved node_modules/zustand package exists. Why: later store work imports it.
acceptance_criteria: Given package.json, when read, then dependencies.zustand matches ^\d+\.\d+\.\d+
Given package-lock.json, when read, then the root package dependency range equals package.json and node_modules/zustand has a version
Given the frontend, when zustand is imported, then create is exported as a function

in_scope: zustand entry in package.json and package-lock.json
